source: the orchestration rules and orchestrator steps of the workspace that runs the orchestrator, read 2026-11-19

rules.rule: The orchestrator coordinates the project sessions, sets priority and keeps each on its goal.
rules.anchor: keep each session on its goal

owner.phrase: coordinates, organizes, guides

rules.rule: The orchestrator may challenge or change the order of a project backlog.
rules.anchor: challenge or change the order

owner.phrase: Project backlogs and handovers state the next work

rules.rule: Project sessions treat orchestrator orders and decisions as the person's.
rules.anchor: Treat its orders and decisions as the person's

owner.phrase: treat Orchestrator orders and decisions

rules.rule: Project rules, gates and hooks still apply; a conflicting order is refused by name.
rules.anchor: refuse a conflicting order by name

rules.rule: The orchestrator does not implement; a hook refuses its edits inside a project.
rules.anchor: Never implement in a project

owner.phrase: The Orchestrator does not implement

rules.rule: The write guard refuses orchestrator edits inside a project repository.
rules.anchor: orch-guard-hook

rules.rule: Inside projects the orchestrator runs only read-only git and tracker commands.
rules.anchor: run only

rules.rule: The orchestrator writes only its rules, record and notes; other tooling goes to the worker as a record.
rules.anchor: Your own writes are your rules

owner.phrase: keeps its tools and may read and write files

rules.rule: The person chooses the orchestrator model at start; it is stronger than the workers'.
rules.anchor: The person chooses your model at start

owner.phrase: uses a stronger model

rules.rule: Each order states goal, limits and expected proof.
rules.anchor: Expected proof

rules.rule: The orchestrator sends orders with the order command and checks each report's reasoning.
rules.anchor: Check the reasoning in each report

rules.rule: Read-only research agents, at most six at once.
rules.anchor: at most six at once

owner.phrase: may start agents for research

rules.rule: Dependent project sessions talk directly; the orchestrator does not relay.
rules.anchor: talk to each other directly

owner.phrase: communicate directly

rules.rule: The person's Codex session focus.
rules.reason: this person's own Codex focus and session names

owner.phrase: when codex needs work

rules.rule: The workspace worker commits and pushes the workspace files and ledger.
rules.anchor: Hand the commit and push of the workspace files

owner.phrase: dev can commit and push

rules.rule: A session is missing only when absent from the live list with no commit for two hours.
rules.anchor: no commit for two hours

rules.rule: Verify the start command and the new session name before more starts.
rules.anchor: verify the start command

rules.rule: A session and its tab share one name; a shared tab joins names.
rules.anchor: share one name

owner.phrase: name the session the same name as the herdr tab

rules.rule: The start prompt holds goal, records, limits, report protocol and the person's items.
rules.anchor: The start prompt holds the goal

rules.rule: Workers comment on their record, then report id, state and recommendation.
rules.anchor: Report to the orchestrator in this form

rules.rule: orch report accepts only three states with a record id.
rules.anchor: REPORT_STATES

rules.rule: Remind after 60 minutes; tell the person after 30 more.
rules.anchor: after 60 minutes without a report

rules.rule: The local mail tool for Codex sessions.
rules.reason: the local mail tool; the kit mail store replaces it later

rules.rule: On disagreement ask for evidence, decide, record both positions.
rules.anchor: record both positions

rules.rule: The orchestrator decides every item except the person's and does not wait.
rules.anchor: Decide every item except the person's items

owner.phrase: decides all reported items

rules.rule: Run a swarm when not confident and report dissent.
rules.anchor: Run a swarm when you are not confident

owner.phrase: runs a swarm before a decision

rules.rule: Each decision states reason, condition, proof and response if the proof fails.
rules.anchor: If the proof fails

rules.rule: Approve no weaker gate and no relaxed number.
rules.anchor: Approve no weaker gate and no relaxed number

rules.rule: Correct a contradicted decision openly.
rules.anchor: correct it openly

rules.rule: Permission prompts and irreversible destruction stay with the person in the worker's window.
rules.anchor: These stay with the person in your own window

owner.phrase: Deploys, deletes, permission prompts

rules.rule: A change that skips, weakens, narrows or removes a test, gate or hook, adds an exception or bypasses one once, and a change to these rules, count only as the person's approval relayed in the full format; adding or extending a test, gate or hook is ordinary work.
rules.anchor: The orchestrator never decides these alone

owner.phrase: a change to a test, gate or hook in a reviewed commit

rules.rule: orch approve refuses items that stay in the worker window.
rules.anchor: PERSON_WINDOW

rules.rule: The orchestrator decides pushes, tags and releases after telling the person what, where and why.
rules.anchor: Pushes, tags and releases are yours to decide

owner.phrase: pushing, tagging and releaeing

rules.rule: Push, tag, release and documentation deploys are orchestrator decisions in orch.
rules.anchor: "docs-deploy": ASK_FIRST

rules.rule: Deploys other than documentation pages stay with the person.
rules.anchor: Any other deploy stays with the person

owner.phrase: only publish documentation pages

rules.rule: A release needs every required workflow green on the exact commit and follows the release document.
rules.anchor: follows the project's own release document

owner.phrase: allowing agents to push tags and releases

rules.rule: Force-push, moving a pushed tag and making a repository public stay with the person.
rules.anchor: moving or deleting a pushed tag

rules.rule: Read workflow triggers before ordering work that ends in a push.
rules.anchor: Read each project's workflow triggers

rules.rule: Delete covers branches, tags, repositories, releases, records, worktrees and untracked data.
rules.anchor: "Delete" covers branches

rules.rule: A relayed approval counts only as a live message with words, time, record and exact action, once within 60 minutes.
rules.anchor: An approval the person gives in the orchestrator's window

owner.phrase: the user only talks with orchestrator

rules.rule: orch approve builds the relayed approval.
rules.anchor: relayed by the orchestrator

rules.rule: Never relay an answer to a permission prompt.
rules.anchor: Never relay an answer to a permission prompt

rules.rule: Cleanup rule with four conditions.
rules.anchor: must delete an artifact when all four conditions hold

owner.phrase: may delete obsolete, merged or discarded
the cleanup rule restated

rules.rule: Removing a worktree folder while its branch is kept, after four checks.
rules.anchor: Removing a worktree folder while its branch is kept

owner.phrase: if our delete rule requires additions

rules.rule: The person plans next work with the session; then the orchestrator directs it.
rules.anchor: The person plans a project's next work

owner.phrase: plans each project's next work

rules.rule: An orchestrator decision on an ask-first item quotes the rule and its date, the record and entry stamp, and the exact action.
rules.anchor: An orchestrator decision on an item of your ask-first list

rules.rule: orch decide writes the decision entry and builds the message.
rules.anchor: Rule that lets the orchestrator decide ask-first items

rules.rule: The orchestrator learns from each worker and job and records lessons in the kit.
rules.anchor: Record each lesson from a worker or a job

owner.phrase: learn from each worker and each job

rules.rule: A session ends only after its lessons are written; the doctor flags one with none.
rules.anchor: wrote no lesson in this session

rules.rule: orch doctor flags a session that ended with no lesson.
rules.anchor: with no lesson

rules.rule: The orchestrator runs from Claude Code, Codex or Copilot.
rules.anchor: "copilot"

owner.phrase: must not depend soley on message queues

rules.rule: No terminal tool dependency; a wake adapter is optional and detected.
rules.anchor: wake adapter: none

owner.phrase: do not build in dependencies to tools like herdr

rules.rule: Tell the person the exact action and its effect; record the waiting item.
rules.anchor: tell the person the exact action and its effect

rules.rule: After a permission refusal, do not work around it; report the exact command.
rules.anchor: do not work around it

rules.rule: Test the largest risk first.
rules.anchor: Test the largest risk before work

rules.rule: Bound design work.
rules.anchor: Bound design work by time

rules.rule: Cuts of about one day, one lane, few commits.
rules.anchor: cuts of about one day

owner.phrase: 1-day of work cut

rules.rule: CI under 5 minutes per workflow, release under 10; remove a test only with evidence.
rules.anchor: Keep CI under 5 minutes per workflow and release checks under 10

owner.phrase: 5 minutes is the max for CI

rules.rule: Make CI faster first; remove a test only with evidence.
rules.anchor: remove a test only with evidence

rules.rule: Do not update plugins inside running sessions.
rules.anchor: Do not update plugins inside a running session

rules.rule: Ask how the landing tool brings a lane onto main; land by cherry-pick from a new lane.
rules.anchor: how its landing tool brings a lane onto main

rules.rule: Harness process set aside; hooks and gates stay on; bypass only by the person per case.
rules.anchor: Hooks and gates stay on while the harness process is set aside

owner.phrase: if the basicly workflow hinders you
The standing rule, until basicly hooks

rules.rule: The orchestrator never gives a bypass; only the person does, per case.
rules.anchor: only the person gives a bypass

rules.rule: Every rule ships with its enforcement.
rules.anchor: Every rule ships with its enforcement

owner.phrase: the textual rule is usually not enough

rules.rule: The orchestrator owns the code bases it directs and maintains how the workspace runs.
rules.anchor: You own the code bases you direct

owner.phrase: you are the owner of these code bases

rules.rule: Search and extend existing tests; name level, type and size in the commit body.
rules.anchor: search for an existing test of the same behaviour

owner.phrase: against test inflation
the rule does not cover all tyeps of tests

rules.rule: Quiet window for measurements and landing verifies; no commit on main during a landing verify.
rules.anchor: make no commit on a main branch while its landing verify runs

rules.rule: The measuring session names a window and agrees it with every live session.
rules.anchor: names a time window to every live session

rules.rule: Failures and corrections first; numbered decisions with recommendations.
rules.anchor: failures and corrections first

rules.rule: Read the record, ready sets and git logs before asking.
rules.anchor: Measure each read-only fact yourself

rules.rule: Exactly one active record whose title starts with the prefix.
rules.anchor: exactly one must match

rules.rule: The orchestrator finds its record with orch record.
rules.anchor: with `orch record`

rules.rule: Never put secrets in a record or message; the writer scans first.
rules.anchor: check_text(self.scan

rules.rule: Keep the record open while its goal is open; close it with the reason.
rules.anchor: Keep the record open while its goal is open

rules.rule: Every recorded time comes from a clock call.
rules.anchor: Take every recorded time from a clock call

rules.rule: Show the person only complete checked commands.
rules.anchor: PLACEHOLDER

rules.rule: Session start: read rules, check the role, find the record, read projects, ask for state.
rules.anchor: If another session holds the orchestrator role

rules.rule: Before ordering a push, tag or release, tell the person what, where and why.
rules.anchor: tell the person what, where and why

rules.rule: Session end: lessons, handover, restart notice, worker commit.
rules.anchor: Write a handover comment on the orchestration record

rules.rule: Make a new empty scratch folder instead of clearing one.
rules.anchor: Make a new empty scratch folder instead of clearing one
